channel.title: Japan Life Info - Visa
channel.description: Japan visa and residence status information

item.title: Complete Guide to ID Photo Requirements for Japanese Visa Applications
item.description: ID photo specifications are one of the most common mistakes in visa applications. Learn the correct size, conditions, and reasons for rejection at a glance.

item.title: Residence Card Address Change in Japan: Deadline and Penalties
item.description: Learn how to report your address change on your residence card after moving in Japan. 14-day deadline, required documents, penalties, and practical risks.

item.title: Complete Guide to Residence Card Address Change Procedure in Japan
item.description: Step-by-step guide to changing your address on your residence card in Japan. Same city vs different city procedures, required documents, processing time, and important notes.

item.title: Penalties for Not Carrying Your Residence Card in Japan
item.description: Learn about the obligation to always carry your residence card in Japan, penalties for violations, when you may be asked to show it, and exceptions.

item.title: What to Do When You Lose Your Residence Card in Japan
item.description: Step-by-step guide on what to do if you lose your residence card in Japan. Police report, reissuance within 14 days, required documents, and overseas loss procedures.

item.title: Can I Apply for a Japanese Spouse Visa Right After Marriage Registration?
item.description: Learn about the timing, review points, and precautions for applying for a Japanese spouse visa after international marriage.

item.title: Top Reasons Why Japan Spouse Visas Get Rejected
item.description: Learn the main reasons spouse visa applications are denied in Japan. Understand fake marriage suspicion, financial requirements, and stay history issues.

item.title: Fastest Route from Spouse Visa to Permanent Residency in Japan
item.description: Learn the fastest path from a spouse visa to permanent residency in Japan. Understand the 1-year application possibility, key requirements, and realistic timelines.

item.title: Emergency Actions Before Your Visa Expires (Japan Status of Residence Guide)
item.description: A guide on what to do when your visa expiration date is approaching. Learn about the grace period, overstay consequences, and prevention tips.

item.title: Complete Guide to Japanese Status of Residence Application Fees and Costs
item.description: A comprehensive summary of official fees and administrative scrivener costs for new applications, renewals, and changes of status of residence in Japan.

item.title: Benefits of Obtaining Permanent Residence from a Work Visa in Japan
item.description: A summary of the concrete advantages of switching from a work visa to permanent residence, including stability, career freedom, and financial credibility.

item.title: Complete Guide to the COE (Certificate of Eligibility) Process
item.description: A step-by-step guide to obtaining the COE (Certificate of Eligibility) required before working in Japan.

item.title: Common Reasons for Work Visa Rejection in Japan
item.description: Key reasons why Japanese work visas get rejected and how to avoid rejection.

item.title: What happens if you get caught working illegally in Japan?
item.description: If caught working illegally in Japan, you face deportation, re-entry bans, and severe disadvantages in future visa screenings.

item.title: Real Cases of Illegal Employment Detection in Japan
item.description: A compilation of real illegal employment cases detected in Japan. Learn about technical trainee runaways, working outside visa scope, employer penalties, and more.

item.title: How Long Does It Take to Get a Japanese Status of Residence?
item.description: A summary of processing times for new applications, renewals, and changes, plus reasons for delays and how to prepare strategically.

item.title: Can You Change from a Short-Term Visa to a Long-Term Visa in Japan?
item.description: Can you switch from a tourist visa to a work visa while in Japan? Learn the rules, exceptions, and the correct procedure.

item.title: Can You Work in Japan on a Tourist Visa?
item.description: Working on a tourist visa in Japan is strictly illegal. Learn the consequences and legal alternatives.

item.title: Do You Need a Visa to Travel to Japan?
item.description: Whether you need a visa to visit Japan depends on your nationality. Here is a complete guide by country.

item.title: When Should You Start Preparing for Your Japan Visa Renewal?
item.description: A guide on the timing and key considerations for renewing your Japan visa (Application for Extension of Period of Stay). Overstaying even by one day is illegal.

item.title: Japanese Language Requirements Under Discussion — Japan's New Foreign Resident Policy Changes
item.description: The Japanese government is considering adding Japanese language proficiency as a requirement for permanent residency and long-term stay. Learn about the key policy changes and how to prepare.
